shared_candidates.lepeff: lepton efficiency (ASSUMPTION 1 % per lepton; WH 1 lepton, ZH 2 leptons)
shared_candidates.phscale: photon energy scale, m_gg shift of real-photon samples (histosys; 0.5 %, ASSUMPTION)
shared_candidates.scale_sig: QCD scale + PDF of the EW VH signal family (WH, ZH EW; same process class V H jj EW)
shared_candidates.pdf_sig: PDF of the EW VH signal family
shared_candidates.scale_hqcd: QCD scale of QCD VH jj (WH, ZH)
shared_candidates.scale_prompt_qcd: QCD scale of QCD V gamma gamma jj
shared_candidates.scale_prompt_ew: QCD scale of EW V gamma gamma jj
shared_candidates.fakerate: j->gamma fake-photon rate (D39 floor), shared by the fake-photon rows of both channels
shared_candidates.tau_r: tau feed-down +-100 % of the measured uplift (W/Z leptonic samples)
